    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.rank_mul_le_parameters {k : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K] {i : Type u_3} {j : Type u_4} {l : Type u_5} [Fintype i] [Fintype j] [Fintype l] (x : i × j → K) (hx : AlgebraicIndependent k x) (s : Finset K) (A : Matrix l j ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k ↑s)) (h : ∀ (a : i) (b : l), ∑ c : j, ↑(A b c) * x (a, c) = 0) :
    Fintype.card i * A.rank ≤ s.card

    Independent rows satisfy linear equations over a field of parameters. Each independent equation on each row costs one parameter.
